Home.dc.html.title: Home — projects and this computer's station

d1.text:
Decision 1 — Ticket cards — DECIDED (chef, 2026-11-08): as recommended
Keep the cream paper voucher for tickets only (the rail's identity), every other block a dark card?
Recommended: yes.

d2.text:
Decision 2 — The recommended button — DECIDED (chef, 2026-11-08): as recommended
One style everywhere: filled accent (today: half filled, half outlined).
Recommended: filled.

d3.text:
Decision 3 — Density — DECIDED (chef, 2026-11-08): as recommended
Body text 13 px on desktop, 15 px on the phone, one scale of 5 sizes (11 · 13 · 15 · 20 · 28).
Recommended: as drawn.

d4.text:
Decision 4 — Project tabs — DECIDED (chef, 2026-11-08): as recommended
Three tabs: Rail · Stations · Settings. The Kitchen tab's health and time fold into the strip above the rail.
Recommended: three tabs.

d5.text:
Decision 5 — The second's panel — DECIDED (chef, 2026-11-08): as recommended
Docked on the right and folded by a click (today always open), so the rail gets the full width.
Recommended: docked, foldable, open by default.
Plus (chef): the panel is resizable by dragging its left edge, and its width is kept.
